hero-title:
Not trying to impress.
Just trying to make it work.
hero-body: I brew, I draw, I think about systems, and occasionally write something worth reading. Based somewhere with decent coffee.
about-heading:
I make things. And I make
sure they work.
about-text-1: 9+ years leading F&B operations, 4 years in digital creative — and a creative practitioner since 2010. I don't just make things look good, I make the numbers make sense. Menus that move product, brand identities that fit the budget, teams that don't quit. Data-driven when it counts, creative when it matters.
about-text-2: The function matters. The result matters more.
services-heading:
I turn ambiguous problems
into something shippable.
service-1-desc: Ex-Full-time Barista. Now I prefer cheap caffeine over so-called exclusive coffee — I've done enough, seriously.
service-2-desc: I create things based on brief. At least that's how we started the project. The rest? Just give me some space, and let me cook.
service-3-desc: Business, operations, planning, executing and occasionally being the person who asks "why are we still doing this?", or "is this useful?"
interests-heading:
What I do when
no one is watching.
showcase-heading:
All the projects

articles-heading:

before I forgot them.
